site_help:
Paste a YouTube playlist URL (channel playlists work).

Examples:

`youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJtitKU0CAegwL_3j59S7_93IEzvhYcDR`

A channel URL also works — videos come from the channel feed.

This is a community connector (separate from the built-in YouTube Channel connector). Playback uses an in-app embed (Privacy Enhanced Mode by default) with `playsinline` so iOS stays in Tapestry instead of jumping to the YouTube app.
